import hashlib,json,urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
p=Path('/workspace/scratch/riot-deployment.json');r=json.loads(p.read_text());base='https://kco994553-star.github.io/lol-coach/'
def get(path):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache','User-Agent':'LoL-Coach-Riot-Ownership-Verification/1'}),timeout=40) as a:
  assert a.geturl()==base+path;return a.status,a.headers.get('Content-Type'),a.read(16777217)
status,ct,raw=get('riot.txt');expected=b'e777577f-eacd-48b5-9586-479ad49a80a8';assert status==200 and raw==expected
checks=[]
def check(item):
 path,h=item;s,ct,b=get(path);assert len(b)<=16777216;return {'path':path,'status':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'match':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h}
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:checks=list(pool.map(check,r['manifest']['sha256'].items()))
assert all(c['status']==200 and c['match'] for c in checks)
s,_,b=get('build-info.json');assert s==200 and json.loads(b)==r['manifest']
s,_,b=get('');assert s==200 and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r['manifest']['sha256']['index.html']
s,_,b=get('.nojekyll');assert s==200 and b==b''
r.update(status='ACTUALLY_DEPLOYED_HTTPS_VERIFIED',https_verified_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),http_status=status,content_type=ct,exact_body=raw.decode(),exact_bytes=len(raw),newline=False,quotes=False,public_file_checks=checks,public_http_verified=True,portal_verification='USER_ACTION_NOT_PERFORMED')
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'url':r['url'],'status':status,'bytes':len(raw),'exact_match':True,'old_public_files_unchanged':len(r['old_manifest']['sha256']),'total_public_files':len(checks),'portal':'USER_ACTION_NOT_PERFORMED'}))
